ownRead.title: Recursive physical construction
ownRead.description: An open claim retained by the selected v0.2.1 companion.
ownRead.statement: **O1 — Recursive physical construction.** One formed organization causes conditions for another distinct persistent organization, and this repeats. A useful contribution could document even two causally connected stages in one system. No such full universal chain is established by this catalogue.
ownRead.scope: Source-reported open claim, not a demonstrated result or a required proof before publication.
ownRead.body:
## Investigate one part

The missing link is a connected physical sequence, rather than similar examples drawn from different systems. A useful contribution would identify the supplied background, the formed unit, its effect on later conditions and a subsequent organization in the same system. Mark observed, modelled and assumed stages separately. Current companion §34 describes the staged investigation.

Bring a source passage, model, result or objection to [the contribution route](/about/#contribute). You can address this question without accepting the entire proposal. Read [all open questions](/open-problems/) for the surrounding programme.
